Fall 2026.title: The Spanish of the United States
The Spanish of the United States

recentReviews.comment: He was a fine professor. If you need to communicate with him though you'll have to talk to him after class. He doesn't respond to any emails or messages.

I'd definitely recommend taking this course with this Professor Smith as needed for core requirements or as an elective. Listening logs, a few quizzes, a midterm and final project that are easy and well placed throughout the semester. Lectures started off slow simply due to content, but get progressively more interesting throughout the semester.

He's a great professor! You can tell he's very passionate about what he does, and that helped me through all the workload. It consists of music logs, quizzes, and a project of your choosing from his list as your final project,fse. It's definitely an easy class to get a good grade and credit out of the way. You will hear tons of music!
Great lecturer. class was graded on 2 papers, but he gives you ample time to prepare for them. Very very interesting and cool professor. Lots of interesting ethical and moral topics.

Professor Deberg is definitely someone who enjoy philosophy in further critical thinking and analyze both side situationship. However, essay is very important in this class with only 2 essay of the entire semester where the importance of self management and use much given resource as soon as possible. His class are funny and make you think.

He is my toughest Humanities professor ever!! We read about 4,000 pages in semester. Papers progress to Master's level, and checked by the writing lab before submitting. I truly respect the professor! He brought the house down for sure. Prepare for fill in the black tests and quizzes; note cards were allowed but still hard.

He is a good professor. HOWEVER, he is not an easy grader, so I'd suggest that you get comfortable going to the writing center every week, so that your essays are solid. Students who don't get assistance on their essays will recieve a C or a D. You should also participate in class, and if he gives you 40 texts to review for the exam, do it.

Oak Deberg is a wonderful professor! He constantly encourages you to open your mind and think and contemplate the next great idea! Wish I could take him again! Only draw back lots of content in lectures and he will drop you if you miss to many classes by drop date!

Dr. Wooten was great. She offered tons of extra credit on all the exams and provided lots of resources for studying. Grade is composed of weekly quizzes, 4 exams and a final exam, but one of your exams can be replaced by your quiz average. STUDY FOR THE QUIZZES!!! She lectures very fast so be prepared to go over the material outside of class.

Bro makes up stuff on the spot doesnt know how to explain it and writes in chicken scratch. Literally worst experience ive ever had in a class DO NOT TAKE THIS DUDES CLASS. all material had nothing to do with study guides provided and spent most my time learning the concepts on youtube.

Osama was an average professor. My issue was not understanding his lecture due to his strong accent. I found this class very difficult due to the fact that I didn't know what to study for test or quizes. All we had for reference was ALEKS and our textbook. He wouldn't answers students questions regarding assignments. He gave points at the end.

Honestly don't think that this guy wants to teach. Refused to answer basically any questions we had. Wasted time on the last day of class and we didn't get to cover the last chapter we were supposed to cover this semester. It took a lot of us complaining to the Dean and Chair for the smallest amount of progress to occur. Pick another professor.

I tried to cut him some slack because this was his first semester, but oh my god he's so bad at teaching and won't answer questions asked during lecture, won't answer questions about aleks or icklicker, gives no test review or study guide, messes up grades all the time, barely replies to emails, handwrites notes and writes in cursive. avoid

Does not know how to lecture, had the most unorganized testing experience known to man (we had to line up to turn it in, despite doing it on Iclicker, it took 40 minutes each test)
Tests had questions that did not exist in the textbook, and refused to give us credit for it because he can't admit he's in the wrong, ever. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!

Biochemistry is a hard class, but Dr. Usama was very fair and wanted his students to succeed. No study guide for the exams but the exams were curved. Easily the best option for biochemistry if you're a biology major.

There are no recordings or lectures for this course and majority of the work involves reading articles and slides for assignments and quizzes. There is a semester long group project that is worth a major part of grade. Overall to pass this course you must put an exceeding amount of time into this class and not to miss any assignment.

This was one of the weirdest courses I have taken at UTSA. It's fully asynchronous.There is no recorded videos, only 100-150 pages of slides per week along with assignments. Each slide is LOADED with info-paragraphs of info per slide.The info on the slides is great but it can feel like a lot at times. Dr.Richards was always available through email.

The class often lacked clear guidelines and communication, homework and assignments took away A LOT of vital time from the group project, and the added need to "exceed expectations" often felt like a little extra salt in the wound for every mistake made. Ultimately, there was just too much going on in this class and with this professor.

To get an A, you need to "exceed expectations", whatever that means when you have little idea what half her expectations are. Don't like that she doesn't post vital lectures for her async class? "Switch to a different section." Want to work on the semester long group project? Have an assignment, quiz, and reading to take up your time instead.
This was not a good class to take with her, she did not lecture at all and the slides were someone else's. It is clear this course was thrust on her.

I took CS2233 with Mr. Yang but he was very lenient and understanding with grades/deadlines. He was easily accessible outside of class and was always informative and updated us frequently with HW deadlines and exam reminders on Canvas. His lectures were informative and easy to understand, and he has a very good understanding of what he's teaching.
He was fine, just didn't learn as much tho.
Prof Yang is a very fair professor, grading is lenient and assignments are walked through in class. Hard to understand sometimes but don't be afraid to email/ask for help after class.

Teacher doesn't seem to be aware that she's teaching a freshman level course. Coursework feels far too difficult, information feels vague while test questions feel hyper-specific and long-winded. This is a mind-wracking course, you should just take something else for the credit. At least she replies to emails quickly & the textbook is a free PDF...

Class was tough at first but got the hang of things eventually. I would recommend reading the textbook (which was provided free) and using the lectures/power points as backup. Class summaries/questions was a good way to keep the grade up and definitely helped by dropping a few grades when the entire class struggled.

This was one of the most frustrating academic experiences I've had. Prof. Afra was consistently unapproachable when asking for help or clarification. Communication outside of class was minimal at best. If you're genuinely interested in learning geography, I'd recommend looking for a different instructor who's more invested in student success.

She is one of the easiest classes I had this semester. She did change the teaching style towards the end to get more engagement but it was still easy. Her quizzes and exams are on canvas, she allows partners for just about everything. Provides many extra credit opportunities and is very helpful if you have questions. She also has a makeup day.
Nice professor but confusing teaching style

Incredible professor! Extremely knowledgeable in all areas of study. Flexible and always available for questions. Explains difficult material in an easily understandable manner. Very passionate about teaching and ensuring student success. Interesting and engaging lectures, you'll never want to miss class!! (This applies for geochem and astrobio)
Very interesting course. Teaching is excellent, and lectures are highly engaging. Highly recommend.
Dr. Mitra is an amazing lecturer! He is very knowledgeable on the subject in which he teaches and is ready to help out any student. Highly recommend taking one of his courses.
You will not find a more knowledgeable professor when it comes to geochemistry. Would highly recommend.

recentReviews.comment: I took him for Anatomy I lab. Very caring professor who explains the material in an easy-to-understand way. I would definitely take him again.

I had him for A&P 1, he's extremely thorough with his instructions. One thing I will say, you need to be PREPARED!!!! for lab, or else you will stay longer than you have to or not get the grade you want. His tests are really easy and gives really good study guides for the test, although they can be lengthy.

Very thorough with lab instructions and doesn't have a problem with clarifying anything you may have missed. Lab practicals are a bit of a challenge considering how toughly he grades them but as long as you study and complete the other lab modules, you're fine. Be prepared to work on your group presentation all semester!

Great professor, really takes his time explaining the lab and demonstrating how it should be done. He is a tough grader but if you go to his office hours he will do his best to guide in the right direction.

Good Professor to be completely honest, he worked with me when I wasn't able to come to lab and even allowed me to make-up some labs. He sometimes gives extra credit and If you communicate and stay diligent his class will benefit you.

Do not take this class. He goes off topic several times. He's a very well educated professor, but he doesn't know how to relay that to us effectively. You'll end up having to teach everything to yourself as he just reads off the slides.

He's super passionate about what he does, but will go on a 15 minute lecture about something irrelevant to your exam. Very nice guy, pretty softspoken so listen up during lectures. Definitely have to teach yourself the concepts at home, but he genuinely cares about you. He will make you sure you pass his class.
Not the best "teacher", but a great guy who knows what he's talking about. Rambles a LOT in his lectures about small things that will not be on tests. Study the material yourself and you'll be fine.

Honestly, he isn't the worst. He's just...ok. He speaks very intelligently, but consequently, it can be hard to understand him. Most students just end up zoning him out. It also doesn't help that he rambles. Sometimes he has a little attitude. BE PREPARED to study a lot of the material yourself.
Will waste the entire class time explaining specific and complex topics- but unrelated to the lecture. Waste of time.

recentReviews.comment: I really enjoyed Mary's class. It was easy to get a little confused, but studying outside of class helped. She was very passionate and answered questions in detail. The group project can be fun if you work well in teams.
Super approachable, and gives extra points.

This class was way more difficult than I expected. Proctored exams focused on in class examples and "discussions" rather than PowerPoints, so attendance is mandatory. Lectures move quickly, and full PowerPoints aren't provided till before exam. It requires significant time commitment and strong attention as I do not recommend if its not your major.

This class is graded by your 3 highest exams, participation points, and a group project. The exams are passable as long as you study and she offers extra credit every week. She's very understanding as long as you communicate any issues with her. Attendance is apart of the grading system but she provides a significant bump at the end of the term.
She is an overall great professor whenever you need something you can contact her and she will respond pretty quickly. She is very knowledgeable and her lab is very fun.
actually made me good at it! he's super good at communicating and works with you and doesn't judge you for not knowing what's going on. best math teacher i've ever had.
All I can say is, TAKE HIM. Super easy to get an A+. Notes on exams too.

best, best, BEST prof you could ask for! i took quantitative reasoning, and he was amazing at explaining the concepts. if you've ever tried in a class, then you will guarantee get an A. i won't lie that there were a lot of "homework" assignments, but you can submit them near the end of the semester and you just need to do enough to get a 100.
Amazing prof. He helps you if your struggling or have a question and very funny too, if I  had to I would take his class again!
If he is an option, TAKE IT. Best instructor I have ever had in my entire academic career.
Learned a lot about Algebra (Engineering) and even though I am not good at math, I did pretty good in my opinion. Recommended.

Their explanations are ridiculously clear they can take the most confusing topic and break it down so well that by the end you're like, “Wait…that's it? They actually care about their students. Not in a generic “office hours are posted” way, but in a “they remember what you're struggling with and check in later” way.
Super easy A if you complete assignments and put in some effort

truly an amazing professor! very understanding. gives quizzes every tuesday but if you work hard in this class, you should pass. one recommendation I would give is to read the assigned textbook, review the playposits and you should be ok!

Professor Ben is a really nice and chill person, the only problem is that he isn't a good teacher.

During my first semester, he would only read off slides and would always put us in breakout rooms.

Exams are also grade heavy, and extra credit was worth only 2 points.

If you're talking cal 1 in your first semester, pick someone else.

Professor S. gave a great class in Calculus 1. He may talk a little too much in class, but his slides are fully covered, and he gives plenty of time for writing down notes. Overall, a great professor. No make-up exams, though, but he does curve most exams

I found him to be a good professor. He is a nice guy and cares about his students. He will try to keep the class engaged and will answer any questions. Calculus is a tough class, so dedicate time. Complete all of the webworks and do the exam review questions as they are good practice. There is also plenty of extra credit so you should do those too.

Looking at other reviews it seems as if he gets a lot of hate and is a poor instructor. Many students in this class will go about not attending any lectures and complain that he does not teach but if you genuinely engage within the lesson instead of complaining how your are struggling you will find that he does make the class quite simple. Not hard
He cares a lot about this class and wants people to pass. Attendance is not mandatory but it helps if you show up to a few lectures

Definitely take notes, but if you go to tutoring with her, she will guide you- she is super helpful, got my grade from d to b+!

One of the best professors I've had so far. I'm so glad I took philosophy with professor Holzer! Professor Martinez is absolutely amazing! His class is so, so interesting. I came in every day very excited about our new topic. You can tell he cares for his students. I remember during the first few weeks of class he would go around the room and try to remember everyone's names. He is so nice. It's a pretty easy and entertaining class.

really nice and puts an effort into his slides & getting to know students. never shows a bias and will respectfully ask questions if he doesn't understand a students take. thorough with his points and writes a quiz review that is very straightforward. would not recommend missing a class. readings are provided on canvas for every lecture

He's a pretty funny and chill professor and will help you if you ask for it but can not teach. He's somewhat full of himself and by me telling y'all that y'all get the gist of knowing what kind of guy he is. Overall its a lot of unnecessary hw and assignments js study aleks and you'll be fine.

Dr.V is an amazing professor. I was nervous because of his reviews, but I'm glad I look his class! ALEKS is a big part of your grade(no reminders), so stay on top of it! Dr. Z teaches in a way that makes concepts easier to understand, and tends to add a bit of humor now and then.

A diamond in the rough professor here at UTSA when it comes to Algorithms. He makes sure to understand that you (the student) understand what is going on slide-by-slide. Even though they are posted online, it is beneficial to you to attend and participate every week and not miss out on what goes on.

Dr. Z is the highest quality professor I have had. He clearly knows and loves his field and this course, and makes no exception in his attempts to truly teach every one of his students. Excellent answers to any questions, and hilarious anecdotes breaking up informative lectures. Take him if you can! The character limit hinders my full endorsement!

Could not recommend this professor enough for Algorithms. Makes it worthwhile to attend every lecture not just for how much care and attention is put into the slides and to get you (the student) to understand them. His teaching style is one to not miss out on during your time at UTSA and made me interested even further into the CS degree

As long as you put in some effort into reviewing and studying, his class is genuinely really easy. He also has great, detailed lectures, and has some extra credit opportunities if you tend to struggle a little bit.

Amazing professor. His lectures were very well formatted and I don't think any other professor would've been able to explain these confusing topics as well as he did. The homework never felt overwhelming. Homework/quizzes/exams were open note. As long as you go to the lectures and actively listen, you will do very well in this course.

Professor Das was by far one of my favorite professors in all of college. He facilitates a classroom environment where class participation isnt so daunting. Use notebook lm to study she suggests it!

Great professor, super knowledgeable and passionate about what is being taught. Of course if you are talking in class during her lecture, she will be upset, but who wouldn't? People say this class is hard to keep up in lectures but she tells us in the beginning of the semester to take notes on smartbook before lecture and then listen to lecture.

I took this prof for BIO II, she is actually amazing. I love it when you can see how passionate someone is about what they teach. There are smart books due on Saturday and a test every 3 weeks, the final was not cumulative. I read my smart books and took notes before lecture and listened to every lecture. She made every topic interesting!

The class is structured well, it shouldn't really matter who teaches. For Ms. Clanton, its not too hard to score well in the class, as the pre-lab quizzes aren't bad as long as you do the postlab and at least skim the reading. She is only strict when it's justified, and the class is structured to allow mistakes. If you want an A, you can get it.

I had Professor Clanton for both my Biology ll Lecture and Lab and wouldn't recommend her. In one of our lectures she was teaching and we weren't being disrupted by people talking and she made this big show about people not caring about the lecture and talking over her...everybody looked around like what is this lady talking about? She's rude.

Professor Karia is an informative, helpful teacher. While her lectures aren't entertaining, they are useful mainly for review. She is highly receptive to feedback and questions, even adjusting a test error after students voiced complaints. Like any college course, independent effort is required, but I highly recommend her!

For a first science lecture class its tough and makes you want to go to sleep. She very knowledgeable but doesn't make lectures fun and if you don't understand its gets boring after the first month. She's not a bad professor by any means but for incoming freshmen it's not ideal.
She is amazing and genuinely wants her students to succeed! Very much willing to listen and help in any way she can! I would 100000000% recommend!

Had Karia in b2b semesters for 1203 and 2313; amazing professor who ensures lecture body understands the content by utilizing real examples with great detail. Dr. Bijal was amazing, and despite her reading straight off the slides, she always goes further into detail and will answer any questions. She's willing to help, and around final exams, she'll offer extended office hours for all students. The material is difficult, but she provides plenty of reviews.

Do not be mistaken; I had to put in a lot of work for my grade. Wrote pages and pages before every exam. But Professor Fox made it a ton easier for me. Incredible guy and always has your best interests in mind. His sessions are entertaining and while the group project is mandatory, he will be accommodating. Spots with him fill up quick so act fast

Dr. Fox is a great lecturer, and the class isn't too bad. Extremely achievable to get an A/A+ if you study for it. Tests are pretty easy, just a lot of information (especially tests 1 and 4). Super fun to talk to, decent amount of extra credit, and the group project is easy as well. Homework is McGraw hill, and they can be long so plan accordingly.

Very chill professor. Will be honest I was very distracted during class since I sat with my friends but he provides good resources to study and gives curves on tests occasionally. Best bio 2 professor for sure!

Very funny and engaging professor, I enjoyed every lecture I attended, and I never dreaded going to his class. The only thing is he doesn't make study guides, but the exams are super easy. Funniest professor I've had, highly recommend.
He's one of the best professors I've had. I would recommend him over any other professor for biology and genetics. He's really kind and genuinely cares about helping his students.

Sure, Dr. Johnson is a bit monotone, but if you can get past that, he's really a great professor. He's the essence of a good teacher. I was scared about taking this class based on past reviews, but he's actually a pretty good prof. Sure, he's monotone, but his expectations are really clear and he can be funny. McGraw-Hill is used, but as long as you know the material from the slides, this class is easy. I recommend him!

He's not bad but he's definitely not good. He just sounds bored when he's teaching. Takes attendance using iClicker and uses that for a grade. I personally wouldn't take him again, he just makes it so hard to retain information. Mainly reads off slides during class.

recentReviews.comment: Easiest class I've ever taken. He's super sweet and nice. I passed one test in his class and still managed to do really well in his class. Its just another high school math class. Show up to class for attendance, lectures get boring later in the semester, and just participate to pass the class. Test grades depend on participation and he is a very caring professor. Always has time to help after class and office hours.

I highly recommend if you are a little rusty with algebra take this class! The professor is very sweet and caring, if you show up to class and try, he will most definitely help you if you are lost during class or with homework given. He is not heavy on tests or assignments as long as you show up to class and pay attention you should pass the class.

Super nice professor. He gives lots of grace with assignments. Always wants to help you better understand the material. There is quite of decent amount of homework, but it's not very difficult and doesn't take very long to complete.

He is the sweetest professor I have had. No, attendance is not mandatory and he forget about the attendance sheet a lot lol. There are a lot of webworks every week and a lot of units to be covered. But he is very understanding if you miss the deadline once. Just don't take advantage of his kindness :).  I RECOMMEND THIS CLASS 100%

I would take her class again if I could she is very sweet. She has a lot of patience and makes everybody feel seen. She will get to know everybody personally. Extends due dates, accepts late work. For the final we were given two chances and we were able to use a cheat sheet. Definitely recommend her especially if you struggle with this subject.

Extremely nice and kind, always tried to help students and help with grades if you deserve it. Lectures were very helpful but allot of group work and a decent amount of homework on different websites like canvas, desmos, and webwork weekly.

Arguably one of the best math teachers I have ever had. She always came into class with a smile and you can tell she loves doing what she does. She always created opportunities for outside-of-class help and made sure to keep updated on any extra credit options. Her willingness to help whenever possible made the class feel welcoming.

She is one of the most caring, empathetic and accessible professors. She learned most of our names by the second week and she doesn't hesitate to help you. She explains the topic material very well and provides you with many ways to succeed. The textbook was free and there is a weekly quiz, but you're allowed a page full of notes to help you pass.

This professor is so caring and kind. She grades work in a timely matter and her lectures are easy to follow and retain. This assignment are done in class for the most part so you won't have homework to take home. She always available and makes learning so much fun.
Awesome instructor highly recommend.

The professor is enthusiastic and enjoys teaching. Easy to go up to and asks questions. The class itself is easy if you do your notes and assignments as the quizzes are easier than what is assigned as homework.
so sweet and a very easy class

Professor Q. is such a nice teacher, she cares about her students to do well and she explains the math material pretty clearly. Sometimes when you can get stumped on something, you can ask her, and she will help you, either in person, or online. She is very enthusiastic about teaching her class, and it's a pretty simple class. 100% Recommend!!

take her class! i'm in her class right now and is the best so far, it's impossible to fail her class she gives so many opportunities and is super kind and takes the time to actually help her students after class!

Great professor, very organized lectures, and a fair grader. He prepares students for tests and homework well, offers test corrections, and gives partial credit on exams. Very good at explaining concepts and examples-- as someone who's not very good with math I did great in his class and never felt lost or left behind.

Very good teacher. He replies to emails super fast and he gives very good lectures. Attendance is not mandatory but I recommend you to attend. He is NOT a tough grader plus he gives opportunities to move your grade up. The class is easy as long as you don't get behind. I'd say he's a top-tier option if you're unsure on who to pick.

Dr. Toledo was an excellent professor, well-organized, and provided lecture notes. He was receptive to student questions both in and out of class. He responded to emails promptly. Completing exam reviews and doing test corrections increases your exam scores. Attendance was optional.

Toledo was awesome this semester. Offers test corrections to save grade, easy assignments that help with understanding, very quick responses to emails even on weekends, flexible. Lecture isn't mandatory but helpful to attend. Super awesome professor and would def take his class again.
He's awesome! Just pay attention in class and you'll be good. Do all the homeworks, allows test corrections which saved my grade. I would 100% take him again!

He is a great teacher, there is multiple ways for you to get an 100 on an test whether its extra credit or test corrections or both. He is a great lecturer the material was easy to understand, the homework wasn't hard if you went to lecture. My advice is go to class, take notes n do the homework and the test might reflect what is on the homework.

All around awesome professor. Easy to follow during lectures and homework is more than manageable. Tests are very similar to reviews he provides and can get extra credit on tests. Go to class, pay attention, complete homework, you'll do just fine.

Super understanding when life happens. No consequences for missing class other than falling behind. Lectures are very informative and he makes sure he's using what helps us learn best whether it be just going through a pre-made course or by giving examples, he sticks to what we need to know for tests/hw and skips the irrelevant stuff.

one of the best professors i've had, he genuinely cares and tries to make the lectures fun by adding jokes. as long as you're in class and taking notes you'll do great. also his exam reviews are life saving

Professor Olsen was great! I was a commuter student and i did have this class early in the morning so it was hard to pay attention after a long drive but his lessons were clear and as long  you pay attention to his lectures and take notes everything will be good! His reviews for the exams were also very very helpful.
She made Calculus II so easy. Attend class and take notes, and you'll be good.
textbook is free and online, and will drop the lowest test with your final if the final is higher, overall a amazing teacher

By far one of the best math professors at UTSA, there are so many opportunities for extra credit (webwork hw can give you up to 10 extra points on tests) and if you attend lectures she would give us a good idea of the type of questions that would be on tests + specific advice! Attendance is not mandatory but I recommend going to her lectures!!
She was the best professor I had my freshmen year and it was so easy to learn from her.

Dr Koshbin's Calculus class was great and she is by far the best professor I have had in any class thus far in my degree. Her lectures were interesting and informative. She was always available outside of class and made sure all her students were well prepared for exams.

Cannot believe UTSA has not fired this guy. The fact that he has been fired after a year at the previous ten universities he taught at, yet he has been teaching at UTSA for two years just shows how much UTSA does not care about students.

As one of the few people who passed Yuriy's class last semester, I'd like to thank ChatGPT for teaching me everything I know. Basically his approach is to solve problems at lightning speed during class time and comment on what he's doing. If you ask a question, he says that there isn't enough time to answer questions. He also requires ID for tests.

His lectures are often unrelated to the course because he makes math look like a philosophical course that we don't use on the test or the homework. When you ask him a question, he'll skip over it. He's very cruel with the test because it's unrelated to the homework and he's strict on grading.

If Bulka's your only option for cal 2 this semester, just don't take cal 2. His lectures are too theoretical without explanation. His tests take most concepts to the hardest possible form. He's unkind and humiliating in class as well

Don't take this prof. He makes tests harder than other profs on purpose. He obsessively tracks attendance—even timing bathroom breaks—and wastes class time policing students. Attendance isn't even apart of the grade. He rushes lectures, refuses to answer questions, then gets mad when no one asks. It feels impossible to succeed in this class.

Great professor, the exams are very fair, and there is a reasonable amount of homework. Sometimes he gets carried away with the proofs/theory, but I still find it interesting. Calc 2 is hard, and he makes it very manageable.
Just chose someone else. Trust.
Good professor, cares about teaching you, but lectures can be a bit difficult to understand at some points. Extra credit is mandated by the board of professors, but still helps greatly
If you want to really debate if this degree is worth it take this class. And you might need a therapist on speed dial.

Professor Kacaku is a great teacher who cares about his students. His classes are very interactive, and he uses a lot of humor to make the lessons fun. He is a good teacher because he makes complex topics easy to understand,and creates a comfortable space where you can ask questions.He truly supports his student, even agreed to write me a lor!!

Good lecturer and loves to teach. It was his first time teaching in-person since COVID, so a little disorganized at first, but funny. No surprises on exams, similar to examples covered in class and in the textbook. Fair grading. 3x5 two side cheat sheet on midterms, one side page on final. Huge extra credit from MATLAB tutorials and in-class psets.
